The project will replace the existing entrance and provide a modernized entrance portal featuring fully integrated security booths to monitor, screen, and process personnel and vehicular traffic entering the Laboratory. The new portal will provide weather protection for security personnel, enhanced site lighting, and a modern traffic control system designed to improve safety, efficiency, and operational reliability. The upgraded entrance will also complement the adjacent, publicly accessible Science and User Support Center (SUSC) by providing a secure, efficient, and welcoming point of entry to the Laboratory. The scope of work for the contract includes the demolition and removal of the existing security booths and associated infrastructure, and the construction of a new entrance portal facility, including structural systems, utilities, security systems, site improvements, and all supporting infrastructure required for full operational capability. BSA will furnish two (2) prefabricated security booths as Government-Furnished Property (GFP). Solicitation documents are available at the link provided in this notice.
